rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial verb for writing something down so you will remember it.

example.english: Please note down the phone number for me.
example.traditional: 你幫我記低個電話號碼，唔該。
example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 gei3 dai1 go3 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5 m4 goi1

rows.note: Use this when recording information systematically, especially in a formal or written context.

example.english: The meeting secretary will note everyone's opinions.
example.traditional: 會議秘書會記錄大家嘅意見。
example.jyutping: wui6 ji5 bei3 syu1 wui5 gei3 luk6 daai6 gaa1 ge3 ji3 gin3

rows.note: For a banknote, this is the everyday all-purpose Cantonese term.

example.english: I don’t have any change, just a bank note.
example.traditional: 我冇散紙，淨係得張鈔票。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mou5 saan2 zi2 zing6 hai6 dak1 zoeng1 caau1 piu3

rows.note: Use this for a brief written reminder or memo, rather than a letter or banknote.

example.english: I stuck a note on the fridge door reminding everyone to buy milk.
example.traditional: 我喺雪櫃門貼咗張字條，叫大家記住買牛奶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 syut3 gwai6 mun4 tip3 zo2 zoeng1 zi6 tiu4 giu3 daai6 gaa1 gei3 zyu6 maai5 ngau4 naai5

rows.note: Use this when the note is a short personal letter sent to someone.

example.english: I got a note from Mum yesterday.
example.traditional: 我尋日收到阿媽寄畀我嘅信。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 jat6 sau1 dou3 aa3 maa1 gei3 bei2 ngo5 ge3 seon3
